title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 161 (Appointment of additional director, alternate director and nominee director)

content.overview: Section 161 empowers the Board, if authorised by the articles or as the section provides, to appoint an additional director, an alternate director, a nominee director, and a director in casual vacancy. Each category has its own tenure and conditions.
content.glance: Board may appoint: additional (till next AGM); alternate (for director absent from India ≥3 months); nominee (by institution/Government under law or agreement); casual vacancy (remainder of predecessor’s term).
content.study: The articles of a company may confer on its Board of Directors the power to appoint any person, other than a person who fails to get appointed as a director in a general meeting, as an additional director at any time who shall hold office up to the date of the next annual general meeting or the last date on which the annual general meeting should have been held, whichever is earlier. The Board may, if so authorised by the articles or by a resolution passed by the company in general meeting, appoint a person as an alternate director to act for a director during his absence for a period of not less than three months from India. A company may have a nominee director appointed by any institution or by the Central Government or State Government by virtue of its shareholding or any agreement or by the Central Government or State Government in pursuance of any law. Where the office of any director appointed by the company in general meeting is vacated before his term expires in the normal course, the resulting casual vacancy may, subject to articles, be filled by the Board; the person so appointed holds office only up to the date up to which the director in whose place he is appointed would have held office if it had not been vacated. Current-law framing: identify the category (additional / alternate / nominee / casual vacancy); apply the corresponding tenure and conditions.

sections.heading: Additional Director
sections.body: Board may appoint if authorised by articles; holds office up to the next AGM or the last date on which the AGM should have been held, whichever is earlier; cannot appoint a person who failed to get appointed at a general meeting.

sections.heading: Alternate Director
sections.body: Board may appoint if authorised by articles or general-meeting resolution; acts for a director absent from India for not less than three months.

sections.heading: Nominee Director
sections.body: Appointed by an institution or by the Central or State Government by virtue of shareholding or agreement, or by the Central or State Government in pursuance of any law.

sections.heading: Casual Vacancy
sections.body: Board may fill a vacancy in a general-meeting-appointed directorship, subject to articles; appointee holds only for the remainder of the predecessor’s term.

provisions.title: Appointment of additional director, alternate director and nominee director

examples.title: Additional director till AGM
examples.body: The Board, authorised by articles, appoints an additional director in January. The next AGM is in September. The additional director holds office only until that AGM (or the last date on which it should have been held).

examples.title: Alternate for absence from India
examples.body: A director will be outside India for four months. The Board, if authorised, may appoint an alternate director for that period under s. 161.

hypotheticals.question: Can the Board appoint as additional director a person who was proposed and failed to get appointed at the last general meeting?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 161 excludes a person who fails to get appointed as a director in a general meeting from appointment as additional director.

distinctions.title: Board appointments under s. 161 vs general-meeting appointment under s. 152
distinctions.left: Additional, alternate, nominee and casual-vacancy appointments by the Board
distinctions.right: Primary appointment and rotation by the company in general meeting

misconceptions.trap: An additional director continues indefinitely until removed.
misconceptions.correction: An additional director holds office only up to the next AGM or the last date on which the AGM should have been held, whichever is earlier.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 161 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify category (additional/alternate/nominee/casual vacancy). II. Apply authorisation and tenure rules. III. Conclude.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What should submissions contain?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Category; articles/authority; tenure facts; precise relief.

examTips: Four categories: additional, alternate, nominee, casual vacancy.
